title: What Potato Are You?
description: Spiraled, stacked, stuffed, or sweet — answer some deeply silly questions and find out which potato lives in your soul.

questions.text: A wizard offers to turn you into any household object for a day. You pick:

answers.text: A disco ball — pure chaos and sparkle
A well-worn reading chair
The TV remote — always in demand
A string of warm patio lights
Press it immediately. No thoughts, just curiosity
Research who made it first, then decide
Press it once. What's the worst that could happen?
Gather a crowd first so everyone can watch

questions.text: You find a mysterious button labeled 'DO NOT PRESS.' What do you do?

answers.text: Yes. Absolutely. Fetch my castle at once.
Only if I can do it in a ridiculous accent
I'd rather compliment the king until he leaves
Yes, and I'm bringing snacks for the whole crowd

questions.text: Would you like to sit on top of a castle and yell taunts at a British king?

answers.text: Whatever shuffle decides — surprise me
The same beloved album, start to finish
Something upbeat that makes the neighbors smile
Three playlists queued and a backup speaker

questions.text: You're handed a treasure map with a big X on it. What's the treasure?

answers.text: A key to a hidden room that's all yours
Gold. Classic, dependable, iconic gold
A note that says 'the real treasure was the journey' — plus twenty bucks
A chest that keeps opening into more chests
Teleporting, but only to totally random locations
Perfect memory of every good moment
Being instantly liked by everyone you meet
Cheering anyone up with a single sentence
Teach it to breakdance immediately
Let it in, but quietly — you have a routine
Calmly ask what it needs, like this happens all the time
Invite its entire colony in for a party

questions.text: A penguin knocks on your door at 3 AM. You:

answers.text: A jester hat with bells, worn with total confidence
A timeless, goes-with-everything baseball cap
A hand-knitted beanie from someone who loves you
Seventeen hats stacked on top of each other

questions.text: You must wear one hat for the rest of the year. Choose:
Your dream house has one weird feature. It's:

answers.text: A slide instead of stairs
A secret room behind a bookshelf
A porch swing that's always the perfect temperature
A fridge with a smaller fridge inside, both full
Perfect naps
High-fives from friendly strangers
Handwritten thank-you notes
Birthday-party energy, every single day

questions.text: You win a lifetime supply of one thing. You choose:
You're in a talent show tomorrow. Your act is:

answers.text: Improvised interpretive dance. No plan. All heart.
A flawless rendition of a song everyone knows
A heartfelt poem about clouds
Fireworks, confetti cannons, a llama, and a big finale

questions.text: Time travel is real. Your first stop:

answers.text: Somewhere random — spin the globe and go
Back to relive your favorite day, slower this time
Medieval France. No reason. Definitely no reason.
Every era at once, somehow

results.description: You're the fun one — unpredictable, twisty, and impossible not to smile around. Life with you never goes in a straight line, and honestly, that's the whole point.
A timeless icon. You're the classic everyone agrees on — reliable, effortlessly likable, and welcome at absolutely any table. Simple? Maybe. Legendary? Definitely.
You're cozy comfort with hidden depths. You put real care into everything you do, and people who take the time to know you discover there's so much more inside.
Sweet, sunny, and refreshingly different. You bring warmth wherever you go and aren't afraid to stand out from the crowd — people leave your company feeling better.
More is more, and you're proof it works. Bold, generous, and gloriously extra, you pile on the fun and make every moment feel like a celebration.
